content.short: Bluevine is a US small-business banking platform with checking, payments, lines of credit and cards.
content.description: Bluevine, founded in 2013, is a US small-business banking platform that pairs a business checking account with payments, credit and cards. Businesses earn interest on their checking balance, send and receive ACH and wire payments, pay bills, draw on lines of credit and term financing, and issue physical and virtual debit cards to their team. With international payment support and accounting integrations, Bluevine works as a modern alternative to traditional business banks for freelancers, startups and growing small companies. Its mix of accounts, credit and bill pay drives the everyday transactions small businesses depend on.
content.meta: Bluevine offers US small-business checking, payments, credit and cards. Discover Bluevine and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
